host.ask: IP address or host name of the tool's control PLC (or the Modbus TCP gateway in front of it)
host.help: Ask the tool's integrator: on an AJA Orion the Phase II laptop talks to the PLC over a private network, so a second network port or a gateway is usually added for Modbus TCP. Port 502 is assumed; put `port` in config.json otherwise.

unit.help: 1 unless the gateway maps the PLC under another id.
